name: Ephah
title: Midian's son and a descendant of Abraham
summary: Ephah was a son of Midian, who in turn was the son of Abraham and his other wife Keturah. Ephah became the ancestor of a Midianite clan that bore his name, which is later mentioned in connection with trade and camel caravans in prophetic texts. The name Ephah also appears in other contexts in the Old Testament, including as a person from the Caleb lineage.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Midian
keyEvents.description: Ephah is mentioned as one of Midian's sons, and thus a grandson of Abraham through Keturah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Books of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Efa is listed in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles as one of Midian's sons, confirming his place in Abraham's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Efa's camel caravans in Isaiah's prophecy
keyEvents.description: The prophet Isaiah mentions Efa in a prophecy about nations coming to Jerusalem with gold and incense to honor the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's sons by Keturah
keyEvents.description: Abraham had several sons with Keturah after Sarah's death, including Midian who became the father of Efa. Abraham gave gifts to these sons and sent them eastward.

keyEvents.title: Efa in Caleb's lineage
keyEvents.description: Another person named Efa is mentioned as a concubine of Caleb in the genealogies, showing the name's prevalence among Israel's tribes.
